gloss: to pay attention; to be attentive; to be considerate

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to be attentive to; to take care of
definitions.explanation: To direct one's awareness and consideration toward something or someone. Implies thoughtful, ongoing attention rather than a momentary glance.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}に{気|き}を{配|くば}れる{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She is someone who is considerate of those around her.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}に{気|き}を{配|くば}って、{毎日|まいにち}{野菜|やさい}を{食|た}べるようにしている。
examples.english: I'm mindful of my health, so I try to eat vegetables every day.

notes:
A common expression meaning to direct one's attention and care toward something. Composed of {気|き} (spirit, attention) and {配|くば}る (to distribute), so the literal sense is "to distribute one's attention." Implies a sustained, proactive awareness rather than a momentary focus.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]に{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to [noun]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全|あんぜん}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to safety
- {健康|けんこう}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to be mindful of one's health
- {周囲|しゅうい}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to be attentive to one's surroundings
- {細部|さいぶ}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}をつける: to be careful — focuses on avoiding danger or mistakes, more about caution
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う: to pay attention — more formal, similar meaning
- {目|め}を{配|くば}る: to keep an eye on — emphasizes visual monitoring
- {心遣|こころづか}い: consideration, thoughtfulness — noun form of a similar concept
